why: The goal says what is added to which message, the details say why and in what form, and the criterion names what an invitation must show.

contract.title: Show the time zone in invitations
contract.goal: Show the event's time zone after the start time in the invitation messages that the Hollowbrook events app sends to guests.
contract.details: Guests in other countries have arrived at the wrong hour. Use the short name of the zone stored on the event, such as CET.

criteria.text: An invitation for an event stored in the Europe/Berlin zone shows the start time followed by CET or CEST.
An invitation for an event stored in the America/New_York zone shows the start time followed by EST or EDT.
